id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

columns.description:
The columns: `columnId`, `title`, `type` (text, number, percent,
dropdown, checkbox, date or time), and optionally `width`, `align`,
`style`, `headerStyle`, `formatOptions` (Intl.NumberFormat options),
`values` (a dropdown's options), `nonEditable`, `className` (every cell
also has `rg-col-<columnId>`) and
`editableWhen` (rules on the row's other values, see `rulesHold`; a
cell whose rules fail is locked and has the class `rg-cell-na`). A cell
the user can edit has the class `rg-cell-editable`, tinted light blue;
set `--drg-editable-cell-color` to change the tint.

data.description: The rows, each an array of values in column order.

rowIds.description:
An id per row of `data`. Given, edits name rows by these ids, rows the
user adds get ids starting `new-`, and rows can be deleted from the
context menu. Omitted, rows are named by position.

newRow.description:
The values a row the user adds starts with: an array in column order, or
an object by column id. Blank if omitted.

lockedCells.description: Cells the user cannot edit, as `[rowId, columnId]` pairs.

readOnly.description: Whether every cell is locked, no row can be added and none deleted.

hiddenColumns.description: The ids of columns not to show; their values stay in `data`.

edits.description:
The edits behind the latest change to `data` (read only): `seq`, which
increases with every change, and `edits`, each one of
`{kind: "cell", rowId, columnId, value}`, `{kind: "add", rowId}` or
`{kind: "remove", rowIds}`.

selectedRowIds.description: The ids of the rows the selection covers (read only).

isExtendable.description:
Whether the table shows a blank row after its data, which becomes a new
row once the user types or pastes into it.

rowPageSize.description: Maximum data rows shown on one page for large tables. Page-local selection and clipboard operations.

virtualRowCount.description: Total number of logical rows supplied by the server. Setting a nonnegative integer enables continuous server-side virtualization.

virtualDatasetId.description: Stable identity of the ordered server dataset; change when sorting, filtering or rebuilding rows to invalidate cached windows.

virtualRowHeight.description: Fixed row height in pixels, default 25.

virtualWindowSize.description: Target number of rows to request on each scroll window, default 120.

virtualViewportHeight.description: Scrollable grid height in pixels, default 420.

virtualRequest.description: Browser request {datasetId, requestId, start, end}, with zero-based start inclusive and end exclusive.

virtualData.description: Server response {datasetId, requestId, start, rowIds, data} containing exactly the requested rows, or a matching {error}.

virtualRangeRequest.description: Read-only absolute-range clipboard request containing datasetId, requestId, start, end, columnStart, columnEnd.

virtualRangeData.description: Server response echoing clipboard request boundaries with text or error.

virtualSelection.description: Compact absolute selection with half-open row/column indices, including unloaded rows.

virtualExportUrl.description: Optional app-provided authenticated URL for streaming selected rows as CSV.

transmitSparseEdits.description: Publish only the edits event to Dash, keeping the updated table locally in the browser. External updates to data or rowIds replace the local table.

editAck.description: Durable server acknowledgment {datasetId,streamId,seq,status,message?}. Only status ok advances the edit queue.

editDatasetId.description: Stable dataset identity required for durable sparse edits and reload recovery.

dropdownMenuPortal.description:
Whether dropdown menus render in a portal on the page body, with fixed
positioning, rather than inside their cell. Turn it on when the grid sits
in something that clips or scrolls, such as a card or the grid's own
scroll area, so menus can extend past its edges and show above nearby
content. Off by default, which keeps ReactGrid's own dropdown.

setProps.description:
Dash-assigned callback that should be called to report property changes
to Dash, to make them available for callbacks.

virtualClipboardUrl.description: Authenticated same-origin endpoint streaming selected rows as Excel-compatible TSV; Ctrl+A Ctrl+C works across unloaded server rows.
